entities.name: Purraj
entities.description: Cold-hearted leader of Urborg's panther warriors and Kaervek's main ally during the Mirage War.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: Urborg mage who waged war on Jamuraa.

entities.name: Jolrael
entities.description: Mage manipulated by Kaervek into a war.

entities.name: Mangara
entities.description: Kaervek's nemesis imprisoned in the Amber Prison.

entities.name: Amber Prison
entities.description: Prison in which Kaervek held Mangara; shattered by Asmira's ritual.

entities.name: Asmira
entities.description: Weatherlight crew member who completed the ritual freeing Mangara at the cost of her life.

entities.name: Rashida Scalebane
entities.description: Leader of the Scalebane's Elite who donned a dragon mask.

entities.name: Forena
entities.description: Member of the Scalebane's Elite who believed Purraj dead.

entities.name: Mirage War
entities.description: War on Dominaria during which Purraj served Kaervek.

events.summary: Kaervek relocates to Jamuraa and manipulates Jolrael into a war; Purraj oversees infiltration of the Mwonvuli and Uktabi jungles.
events.quote: Purraj helped oversee an infiltration of both the Mwonvuli and Uktabi jungles.

events.summary: Purraj supervises the invasion of Femeref and Zhalfir and guards the Amber Prison holding Mangara.
events.quote: was a guardian of the Amber Prison

events.summary: The Weatherlight crew with Asmira and Rashida's elite assault the Amber Prison; Rashida's dragon mask lets her strike down Kaervek's forces.
events.quote: She was able to strike down Kaervek's forces in a dizzying attack

events.summary: Purraj, sole survivor, delivers lethal blows to Asmira, who still completes the ritual; the prison shatters and Mangara is freed.
events.quote: Purraj was the sole survivor and leapt at Asmira, delivering lethal blows.

events.summary: Purraj disappears in the flash of light and her body is never found.

relations.quote: Purraj was the main ally of the Urborg mage Kaervek .

relations.note: led many of Urborg's panther warriors
relations.quote: was the leader of many of Urborg 's panther warriors
